_meta.description: Structured upgrade rules derived from meta research. Used as reference for recommendation engine logic.
_meta.changelog: v1.1 (2026-04-01 Pass 2): Added dungeon class meta, equipment accessories, money-making tiers, slayer Vampire, mining Glacite Tunnels details, farming Fortune formula, level gates, beginner mistakes

new_system.description: 30 milestones based on total donated item value

critical_path.note: F5 unlocks Shadow Assassin armor — critical power spike

bis_pet.name: Black Cat
bis_pet.reason: S+ rank speed boost for faster dungeon runs

zombie.note: Level 4 to WEAR Revenant armor, Level 5 to CRAFT chestplate

critical_blocker.recommendation: Select a Magical Power at the Accessory Bag

magical_power.note: There are no hard mechanical breakpoints at 200/400. The 250/500/750/1000 are community reference points for progression milestones.

armor_progression.outdated_old_path: Zombie Soldier → Hardened Diamond → Perfect Armor → Superior Dragon → Necron

bis_pets.farming_old_bis: Elephant (still strong, no longer clear BIS; best for max Farming Fortune)

class_by_stage.reason: Best DPS options available (AotD, Strong Dragon Armor), 64.6% community vote
Slight edge (27.7% vote) over Mage (24.6%) and Berserker (21.5%); Spirit Shortbow / Juju Bow
Dominant (49.2% vote); Terminator is the weapon trigger
Terminator (Archer) or Hyperion (Mage); Mage requires expensive gear

dungeon_class_meta.transition_rule: Play Berserker until you acquire Terminator (switch to Archer) or Hyperion (switch to Mage)
dungeon_class_meta.tank_note: Situationally valuable on F7 for boss positioning; less critical at high Catacombs
dungeon_class_meta.healer_note: Effectively obsolete at F6+; not needed in modern party compositions

equipment_accessories.master_starred_note: NOT cost-effective — described as 'the very last upgrade possible' with minimal stat gain

combat.name: Shadow Assassin Armor
combat.note: SA + Livid Dagger (Berserker) or SA + Spirit Sceptre (Mage)

combat.name: Necron's Armor / Wither Armor sets
combat.note: Necron better inside dungeons due to scaling; outside dungeons barely worth price increase vs SA

combat.name: Kuudra Infernal Armor
combat.note: Better raw stats than Necron; Necron retains value for dungeon bonuses

farming.name: Helianthus Armor
farming.note: Requires Farming 50; drops from Moonflower/Sunflower/Wild Rose (2+ Fermento/Helianthus pieces); also from Greenhouse Harvestable crops

mining.name: Divan's Armor
mining.note: Full Recombed Jaded Divan with Perfect Topazes recommended

zombie.note: Level 4 to WEAR Revenant armor, Level 5 to CRAFT chestplate. Do L1 first for Wand of Healing (16 Revenant Flesh).

wolf.note: L2 unlocks Radiant Power Orb recipe

vampire.note: T5 most profitable but requires ping <40ms. T4 viable if T5 too difficult, set RNG meter to The One books. New Erythrocyte currency from Vambus NPC.

glacite_tunnels.secret_railroad_pass_recipe: 1 Flawless Ruby + 2 Refined Mithril + 8 Corleonite (30s forge)
glacite_tunnels.recommended_drill: Titanium Drill DR-X555 minimum; DR-X655 for HOTM 10+
glacite_tunnels.recommended_armor: Yog or Divan (NOT Sorrow or Glacite armor)
glacite_tunnels.recommended_armor_note: Glacite armor is explicitly discouraged by community for use in Glacite Tunnels
glacite_tunnels.recommended_drill_reforge: Auspicious or Lustrous (NOT Glacial — that is a drill reforge but was misidentified as armor reforge in some guides)

mining.mithril_mining_note: Nobody mithril mines for income anymore — only for powder. Gemstone mining is the primary income method.

farming_fortune.formula: Every 100 FF = +100% drops. Leftover FF = % chance for one more drop multiplier. Example: 250 FF = 100% chance for 3x drops + 50% chance for 4x drops.

key_enchantments.name: Dedication IV
key_enchantments.effect: +0.5 per garden milestone for that crop (hoes/axes only)
key_enchantments.note: Multiplied by garden crop milestone; max with tier 4

key_enchantments.name: Green Thumb V
key_enchantments.effect: +0.25 per unique visitor served per equipment piece; max +21/piece with 84 visitors = +84 total

farming_fortune.farming_fortune_note: Farming Fortune has no effect on Private Island — only works in Garden

level_gates.note: SkyBlock Level 7 unlocks Bazaar (NOT Level 5 as sometimes stated; Garden is Level 5)

money_making.progression_pathway: Farming/Fishing/Ice Walkers → Bazaar Flip (1M start) → Zealots + Craft Flipping → Dungeons F5 + Gemstone Mining → Endgame Minions

methods.name: Gemstone Mining
methods.note: Requires Divan armor + drill; Pristine stat prioritized over Mining Fortune

methods.name: Ghost Farming
methods.note: Soul Whip + Emerald Blade sword swap; requires Fishing 26

methods.name: Dungeons F5
methods.note: 2.5 min runs; most reliable cash floor

methods.name: Worm Fishing
methods.note: Fishing 19+; Worm Membrane up to 100k each

methods.name: Bazaar Flipping
methods.note: Most capital-efficient for new players; zero ban risk; 1.25% tax

methods.name: Zealot Grinding
methods.note: Frozen Diamond armor + Legendary Eman pet + Zealuck 5

methods.name: Rift Berberis
methods.note: Very accessible; get to 3rd Rift area

methods.name: Automaton Grinding
methods.note: HOTM 3 required; less competitive than Zealots

methods.name: Farming (Netherwart)
methods.note: Max T3 hoe + Legendary Elephant pet

methods.name: Pumpkin Minions
methods.note: WARNING: Flagged as bug-based by community — may be patched

mistakes.consequence: Deaths drop purse coins; losing progress
Massive underperformance; accessories are the main long-term power source
Coin waste before having good accessories
mistakes.fix: Don't reforge until mid-game with stable income
Only enchant gear you'll keep for a while

mistakes.consequence: No space for warps, chests, minions later
mistakes.fix: Use stone slabs on main island; don't bridge to extensions
Use Bazaar flipping as stable income base
Experimentation Table, Dwarven Mines commissions (bonus HOTM XP), Chocolate Factory, Community Center
